title: The Piece in Front
setup: Your bishop on b2 is aimed at the black king, and your own knight on e5 is the only thing in the way.
hint: Something of yours is standing between the bishop and the enemy king. What happens the moment it steps aside?
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight is the front piece of a battery. {{Nxd3+}} takes the queen and unmasks the bishop's check on h8 in the same move, so Black must answer the check instead of recapturing. A defended piece is not really defended when taking it comes with check.
